description: This file defines the MenuConfigurator interface within the OrangeHRM Core Menu namespace. It declares a method to configure a screen and return a menu item, serving as a contract for implementing classes to set up menu configurations for different screens.

classes.name: MenuConfigurator
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method to configure a screen and provide a menu item, used for setting up menu configurations in the application.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines a method that takes a Screen object and returns a MenuItem or null, serving as a configuration point for menu setup.
